payload.question: Planting mangroves can help ___ the effects of coastal erosion.
payload.explanation_uz: mitigate – yengillashtirmoq, zararni kamaytirmoq. Mimic (taqlid qilmoq), migrate (ko'chib o'tmoq) va mediate (vositachilik qilmoq) ma'no jihatidan mos kelmaydi.

payload.question: The factory was fined for discharging toxic waste into the river, a clear ___ of environmental regulations.
payload.explanation_uz: breach of regulations – qoidalarni buzish (buzilish). Breakage jismoniy sinishni, breech esa miltiq qismini bildiradi; 'break of regulations' kollokatsiya emas.

payload.question: The old system was ___ in favour of cloud-based software.
payload.explanation_uz: phase out – bosqichma-bosqich to'xtatmoq (bekor qilmoq). Phase in – bosqichma-bosqich joriy qilish, aksi; 'faced out' mavjud emas; put out – o'chirmoq.

payload.question: Early diagnosis significantly improves the ___ for patients with certain cancers.
payload.explanation_uz: prognosis – kasallik oqibati bo'yicha bashorat (prognoz). Diagnosis – tashxis qo'yish, symptom – alomat, syndrome – sindrom; ular kelajak bashoratini bildirmaydi.

payload.question: A sedentary lifestyle is a major ___ factor for heart disease.
payload.explanation_uz: risk factor – xavf omili (barqaror birikma). Danger, threat va peril ma'nosi yaqin, lekin 'factor' bilan birga ishlatilmaydi.

payload.question: Universities are under pressure to widen ___ for students from low-income backgrounds.
payload.explanation_uz: widen access – imkoniyatni kengaytirmoq (kirish imkoniyati). Admission – qabul qilish jarayoni, entrance – jismoniy kirish joyi, exit – chiqish; ma'noga mos emas.

payload.question: The professor's lecture was so ___ that even specialists struggled to follow it.
payload.explanation_uz: abstruse – tushunish qiyin, murakkab (chigal). Obtuse – (odam haqida) sust fikrlaydigan, abstinent – o'zini tiyadigan, obscene – odobsiz.

payload.question: Rising inflation has eroded consumers' purchasing ___.
payload.explanation_uz: purchasing power – xarid qobiliyati (barqaror birikma). Strength, force, might sinonim ko'rinsa-da, bu birikmada ishlatilmaydi.

payload.question: The country's economy has been ___ since the collapse of its main export market.
payload.explanation_uz: stagnant – turg'un, o'smayotgan (turg'unlikdagi). Stationary – joyidan qimirlamaydigan (jismoniy), stubborn – o'jar, sturdy – mustahkam.

payload.question: Reducing the budget deficit will require us to ___ the bullet.
payload.explanation_uz: bite the bullet – qiyin ishga bel bog'lamoq (idioma). Boshqa fe'llar bu idiomada qo'llanmaydi.

payload.question: Social media can ___ existing prejudices rather than challenge them.
payload.explanation_uz: reinforce – mustahkamlamoq, kuchaytirmoq. Reform – isloh qilmoq, relieve – yengillashtirmoq, revoke – bekor qilmoq; mazmunga zid.

payload.question: Rural communities feel increasingly ___ by decision-makers in the capital.
payload.explanation_uz: marginalised – chetga surilgan, e'tibordan chetda qolgan. Magnified – kattalashtirilgan, managed – boshqarilgan, mastered – o'zlashtirilgan; kontekstga mos emas.

payload.question: Prolonged stress can ___ anxiety disorders in vulnerable individuals.
payload.explanation_uz: precipitate – (kasallikni) qo'zg'atmoq, tezlashtirmoq. Preclude – oldini olmoq (aksi), presume – taxmin qilmoq; precede – oldin kelmoq, sabab bo'lishni bildirmaydi.

payload.question: After the loss, she showed remarkable ___ and was back at work within a month.
payload.explanation_uz: resilience – qiyinchilikdan tez tiklanish qobiliyati (chidamlilik). Resistance – qarshilik, residence – yashash joyi, resignation – iste'foga chiqish yoki taslim bo'lish.

payload.question: The tabloid was accused of ___ the facts to create a more dramatic story.
payload.explanation_uz: distort – buzib ko'rsatmoq, burmalamoq. Destroy – yo'q qilmoq, distract – chalg'itmoq, disturb – bezovta qilmoq; 'facts' bilan mantiqan mos emas.

payload.question: News outlets compete fiercely for ___, because advertising revenue depends on audience size.
payload.explanation_uz: readership – o'quvchilar auditoriyasi. Leadership – rahbarlik, membership – a'zolik, ownership – egalik; auditoriya hajmiga aloqador emas.

payload.question: The scandal was ___ by officials at first, but it eventually leaked online.
payload.explanation_uz: hush up – sir saqlamoq, yashirmoq (yopib qo'ymoq). 'Hushed out' mavjud emas; shut up – jim bo'l; hold up – kechiktirmoq yoki talon-taroj qilmoq.

payload.question: Many critics question the ___ of such measures.
payload.explanation_uz: effectiveness – samaradorlik (ot). Effective – sifat, effectively – ravish; 'the ... of' ot talab qiladi. Effectual kam qo'llanadigan sifat.

payload.question: The minister's remarks were deliberately ___, allowing several interpretations.
payload.explanation_uz: ambiguous – ikki xil ma'noli, noaniq. Ambitious – shuhratparast, ambivalent – (odam) ikkilangan his-tuyg'uli, amiable – xushmuomala; so'zlarga tavsif bermaydi.

payload.question: Her ___ attitude to deadlines worried her manager.
payload.explanation_uz: cavalier – beparvo, mensimaydigan (e'tiborsiz). Chivalrous – olijanob, cordial – samimiy, candid – ochiq-oydin; muddatlarga beparvolikni bildirmaydi.

payload.question: The company's lax approach to cybersecurity left customers' data ___ to attack.
payload.explanation_uz: vulnerable to – zaif, himoyasiz. Valuable – qimmatli, variable – o'zgaruvchan, vague – noaniq; 'to attack' bilan ishlatilmaydi.

payload.question: Which word is closest in meaning to 'ubiquitous' in: 'Smartphones are now ubiquitous.'?
payload.explanation_uz: ubiquitous – hamma joyda uchraydigan, keng tarqalgan (widespread). Expensive – qimmat, obsolete – eskirgan, controversial – munozarali.

payload.question: 'The findings of the trial were inconclusive.' This means that the findings:
options: did not give a definite answer
payload.explanation_uz: inconclusive – yakuniy xulosa bermaydigan, noaniq. Boshqa variantlar (yolg'on, keng qabul qilingan, isbotlangan) ma'noga zid.

payload.question: The researchers ___ an unexpected pattern while analysing the data.
payload.explanation_uz: come across – tasodifan duch kelmoq, topmoq. Come over – kelib qolmoq, come round – hushiga kelmoq yoki mehmonga kelmoq, come off – muvaffaqiyatli chiqmoq.

payload.question: The new law was criticised for placing a ___ burden on small businesses.
payload.explanation_uz: disproportionate burden – nomutanosib, haddan ortiq yuk. Disparate – bir-biridan farq qiladigan, dispassionate – hissiz va xolis, disinterested – manfaatsiz xolis.

payload.text: The ___ (sustain) of the scheme depends on long-term funding.
payload.explanation_uz: sustainability – barqarorlik (davomiylik). 'The ... of' ot talab qiladi; sustain fe'li, sustainable sifati mos kelmaydi.

payload.text: Teachers must treat all pupils ___ (equal), regardless of background.
payload.explanation_uz: equally – teng, bir xilda (ravish). Fe'lni ravish aniqlaydi, shuning uchun sifat 'equal' mos emas.

payload.text: Her ___ (reluctant) to speak in public held back her career.
payload.explanation_uz: reluctance – istamaslik, ikkilanish. Egalik olmoshidan keyin ot kerak; 'reluctant' sifat.

payload.text: The report highlights the ___ (significant) of early intervention in education.
payload.explanation_uz: significance – ahamiyat, muhimlik (ot). 'The ... of' ot talab qiladi.

payload.text: The project proved financially ___ (viability).
payload.explanation_uz: viable – amalga oshirsa bo'ladigan, foydali (hayotiy). Ravishdan keyin sifat kerak, 'viability' esa ot.

payload.text: Excessive screen time can have ___ (harm) effects on children's sleep.
payload.explanation_uz: harmful – zararli. 'Effects' otini sifat aniqlaydi.

payload.text: The new law is intended to make companies more ___ (account) to their shareholders.
payload.explanation_uz: accountable – javobgar. 'More' dan keyin sifat kerak; 'accountable to' – oldida javobgar.

payload.text: Regular exercise brings ___ (number) benefits for both body and mind.
payload.explanation_uz: numerous – juda ko'p, son-sanoqsiz. 'Benefits' otini sifat aniqlaydi.

payload.text: The campaign aims to raise a___ of mental health issues.
payload.explanation_uz: raise awareness – xabardorlikni oshirmoq (barqaror birikma).

payload.text: Governments must strike a b___ between economic growth and environmental protection.
payload.explanation_uz: strike a balance – muvozanatni topmoq (idioma-kollokatsiya).

payload.text: The athlete was banned for using performance-e___ drugs.
payload.explanation_uz: performance-enhancing drugs – sport natijasini oshiruvchi (doping) preparatlar.

payload.text: Many graduates struggle to make ends m___ in expensive cities.
payload.explanation_uz: make ends meet – kun ko'rmoq, daromadi zo'rg'a yetmoq (idioma).

payload.text: Eating well and sleeping enough will help you f___ off a cold.
payload.explanation_uz: fight off / fend off – (kasallik, hujumni) daf qilmoq, yengib o'tmoq (qaytarmoq).

payload.text: The government has c___ down on tax evasion.
payload.explanation_uz: crack down on – qattiq choralar ko'rmoq (qattiqqo'llik bilan kurashmoq). O'tgan zamon shakli kerak.

payload.text: It is time we got to the r___ of the problem rather than treating its symptoms.
payload.explanation_uz: the root of the problem – muammoning ildizi (asl sababi).

payload.text: A diet r___ in vegetables and fibre lowers the risk of many diseases.
payload.explanation_uz: rich in – ... ga boy. 'A diet rich in' barqaror birikma.

payload.text: The film received widespread critical a___, winning several international awards.
payload.explanation_uz: critical acclaim – tanqidchilar e'tirofi (yuksak baho).

payload.text: Scientists remain ___ (sceptic) about the claim that the drug cures the disease.
payload.explanation_uz: sceptical – shubhalanuvchi. 'Remain' dan keyin sifat kerak; 'sceptic' – shubhachi odam (ot).

payload.text: Streaming services have ___ (revolution) the way people consume television.
payload.explanation_uz: revolutionise – tubdan o'zgartirmoq (inqilob qilmoq). 'Have' dan keyin o'tgan zamon fe'li kerak.

payload.text: Increased ___ (urban) has put enormous pressure on housing in major cities.
payload.explanation_uz: urbanisation – shaharlashuv. 'Increased' dan keyin ot kerak.
